description: A bed with a dark blue blanket and a pale pink pillow fills the view, with a small white two-drawer nightstand sitting near the middle of the mattress. The left hand reaches forward to steady the nightstand as the right hand grasps a drawer knob and pulls the drawer straight out toward the camera, separating it from the nightstand; the right hand then eases it down beside the nightstand while the left hand releases and rests back.
